learnings: Distinguish between tool errors (API failures) and security findings when determining verdicts - a model that crashes should not produce an 'inconclusive' security verdict
When a model's initial pass succeeds but subsequent passes fail due to transient errors, the initial pass result should be preserved rather than discarded
Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors to avoid incomplete audits that trigger unnecessary escalations
